name: CaseGridImplicitTracks
description: SEED contract for the CSS/DOM conformance fixture case "grid-implicit-tracks" (layout). The fixture varies CSS CONSTRUCTS, not prop spaces, so the prop space is deliberately EMPTY: every axis the capture would enumerate is held at nothing, and the whole measurement is the computed truth of one mounted rendering. Construct: grid-auto-rows: 24px + grid-auto-flow: column
